fusions.name: Least Resistance
fusions.desc: Sends a jet of water at the first enemy it meets that deals 28 damage and ignores resistances. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Sweep
fusions.desc: Sends a sheet of water through a cone 3 tiles deep that deals 7 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Soaked] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Flow State
fusions.desc: You restore 10 health at once, and your cast speed rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Worn Smooth
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
